summary: LB Pharmaceuticals Inc filed an 8-K on July 28, 2026, announcing a private placement of 3,577,560 common shares and 715,513 pre-funded warrants at $34.94 per share-equivalent, raising gross proceeds of approximately $150 million. The warrants are immediately exercisable at $0.0001, subject to beneficial ownership caps of 4.99% or 9.99%. The offering is expected to close on July 30, 2026, and proceeds will be used for company purposes. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
